pkgmetadata.longdescription: Git storage in SQLite. Four independent tools over one shared storage core: git0, a SQLite extension that queries git repositories from SQL and runs a self-contained repository inside a database via a libgit2 backend; git-local-sqlite, a git local helper that stores objects, refs and reflogs in one SQLite file; gitlfs, a standalone git-lfs content store as a SQLite extension; and git-lfs-sqlite-transfer, a git-lfs custom transfer agent backed by the same database.

use.flag: Build the git0 SQLite extension (git0.so), which queries git repositories from SQL; links dev-libs/libgit2
Build git-local-sqlite, a git local helper storing objects, refs and reflogs in SQLite (needs a git with local-helper support)
Build the gitlfs SQLite extension (gitlfs.so), a standalone git-lfs content store
Build git-lfs-sqlite-transfer, a dev-vcs/git-lfs custom transfer agent storing LFS content in SQLite
